project_info.theme: Cool-toned modern idol-influencer portrait with a Kuromi plush
project_info.color_palette: cool white, charcoal black, low-saturation pale pink, silver

main_subject.detail: An adult woman with cool-pale natural skin, delicate refined facial features, expressive eyes, minimal natural makeup, and extra-long low-saturation pale-pink hair styled with a relaxed high crown and face-framing strands. She wears an oversized black graphic T-shirt with a silver chain necklace and gently holds a Kuromi plush toy.

items: vertical half-body portrait against a textured cool-white modern wall
direct composed gaze and casual upright pose
Kuromi plush held at chest height
visible individual hair strands and realistic plush and cotton fabric texture
no additional text or logos beyond any supplied clothing or plush reference

lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: slightly overexposed glow with clean soft contrast
lighting_and_atmosphere.atmosphere: polished cool influencer aesthetic with pale-pink accents against black and white

technical_specs.render_style: Canon EF 85mm f/1.2, sharp eyes and hair strands, shallow depth of field
technical_specs.color_treatment: controlled cool tones, subtle natural skin variation, no artificial smoothing

prompt.generated_prompt_string: High-quality influencer portrait of an adult woman holding a Kuromi plush toy gently in her arms. Casual carefree half-body pose, expressive lively slightly smug direct gaze, cool-girl idol aesthetic. Cool-pale natural skin, delicate refined features, high-bridged nose, defined jawline, narrow elongated expressive eyes, minimal natural makeup. Extra-long low-saturation pale-pink hair with a relaxed high crown, face-framing individual strands. Oversized black graphic T-shirt and silver chain necklace. Textured cool-white fashionable wall backdrop, cool-toned light with slightly overexposed soft glow, Canon EF 85mm f/1.2, sharp macro-level hair detail, strong portrait composition, cool tones and soft pale-pink accents, polished professional realism.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexualized pose, body-part emphasis, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, extra fingers, deformed

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: No reference asset is required. If approved person, wardrobe, plush, or wall references are attached, preserve adult identity where appropriate, pale-pink hairstyle, black oversized tee, silver chain, Kuromi plush, cool-white wall, and half-body composition. Individual styling details may be replaced.
